what: Get a disclosure-safe numeric histogram — ds.omop.value.histogram
title: Get a disclosure-safe numeric histogram — ds.omop.value.histogram
text: Computes binned histogram numeric column OMOP CDM table. scope "pooled", two-pass algorithm used: first pass collects p05/p95 ranges server compute shared bin edges, second pass counts records per bin using shared edges results directly comparable summable across servers. Bins counts disclosure threshold suppressed.

title: Get a disclosure-safe numeric histogram — ds.omop.value.histogram
text: table Character; CDM table name (e.g., "measurement"). value_col Character; numeric column histogram (e.g., "value_as_number"). bins Integer; number histogram bins (default: 20). concept_id Integer NULL; optional concept ID restrict rows single concept table binning (e.g. value_as_number one measurement concept). Default: NULL rows. server applies disclosure controls concept-filtered population. Requires dsOMOP server build histogram concept scoping; older servers reject argument (use concept-scoped quantiles aggregate via ds.omop.value.quantiles() fallback). cohort_table Character; name server-side cohort temp table filtering, NULL (default: NULL). window List start/end date strings temporal filtering, NULL (default: NULL). cohort Cohort reference (dsomop_cohort_handle, cohort_definition_id, server-side cohort table name), NULL. Takes precedence cohort_table. scope Character; "per_site" (default) "pooled". pooling_policy Character; "strict" (default) "pooled_only_ok". symbol Character; session symbol (default: "omop"). conns DSI connection object(s) NULL use session default. execute Logical; FALSE, return dry-run result containing generated call code (default: TRUE). plot Logical; TRUE, draw federation-wide bar chart pooled, shared-edge bins (forces scope = "pooled") return result invisibly. Default FALSE. nbins Integer; number display bins used plot = TRUE (default: 9). xlab, main, col Axis label, title bar colour used plot = TRUE. type Optional result view: "split", "combine", "". pooled plot requires "combine" "". omitted, legacy scope behaviour preserved.

title: Get disclosure-safe numeric quantiles — ds.omop.value.quantiles
text: Computes quantiles numeric column OMOP CDM table. Quantile computation happens entirely server side avoid exposing individual-level data. Note quantiles inherently non-poolable summary statistics alone; scope = "pooled" requested, per-site quantiles still returned warning emitted $pooled slot remains NULL.

title: Get disclosure-safe numeric quantiles — ds.omop.value.quantiles
text: table Character; CDM table name (e.g., "measurement"). value_col Character; numeric column name (e.g., "value_as_number"). probs Numeric vector; quantile probabilities compute (default: c(0.05, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 0.95)). concept_id Integer NULL; optional concept ID restrict rows single concept table computing quantiles (e.g., value_as_number one measurement concept). Default: NULL rows. server applies disclosure controls (including [0.05, 0.95] probability clamp blocks min/max) concept-filtered population. cohort_table Character; name server-side cohort temp table filtering, NULL (default: NULL). window List start/end date strings temporal filtering, NULL (default: NULL). cohort Cohort reference (dsomop_cohort_handle, cohort_definition_id, server-side cohort table name), NULL. Takes precedence cohort_table. rounding Integer; number decimal places round quantile values (default: 2). scope Character; "per_site" (default) "pooled". Pooled quantiles computed (see Description). pooling_policy Character; "strict" (default) "pooled_only_ok". symbol Character; session symbol (default: "omop"). conns DSI connection object(s) NULL use session default. execute Logical; FALSE, return dry-run result containing generated call code (default: TRUE). type Optional result view: "split", "combine", "". Quantiles poolable; "combine" therefore returns pooled value records reason. omitted, legacy scope behaviour preserved.

title: Create a dsomop_result object — dsomop_result
text: Constructs standardised dsomop_result S3 object wraps every dsOMOPClient function return value. object stores per-site results, optional pooled (cross-server aggregated) result, metadata including reproducible R code produced result, timestamp, pooling warnings.

code: dsomop_result(per_site, pooled = NULL, meta = list())

title: Create a dsomop_result object — dsomop_result
text: per_site Named list mapping server names raw results (data frames, lists, scalars). pooled NULL (default) single aggregated result (typically data frame) combining servers. meta Named list metadata. Recognised elements: call_code (character; reproducible R code), scope (character; "per_site" "pooled"), type (character; "split", "combine", ""), pooling_policy (character; "strict" "pooled_only_ok"), warnings (character vector pooling warnings).

what: Build a date handling specification — omop.date_handling
title: Build a date handling specification — omop.date_handling
text: Creates specification controlling date columns transformed event-level outputs. Dates can kept -, converted relative days index date, binned calendar periods, removed entirely privacy.

title: Build a date handling specification — omop.date_handling
code: omop.date_handling(   mode = "remove",   reference = "index",   bin_width = NULL,   date_columns = NULL )

title: Build a date handling specification — omop.date_handling
text: mode Character; transformation mode. Defaults "remove" (privacy-preserving). One "absolute" (keep original dates), "relative" (convert days reference), "binned" (aggregate calendar bins), "remove" (drop date columns). reference Character; reference point relative mode. Currently "index" (cohort index date) supported. bin_width Character; bin granularity binned mode. One "week", "month", "year". date_columns Character vector; specific date columns transform. NULL, date columns output transformed.

title: Build a date handling specification — omop.date_handling
text: list elements mode, reference,   bin_width, date_columns.

title: Build a date handling specification — omop.date_handling
code: if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{ # Convert dates to days relative to cohort index dh <- omop.date_handling(mode = "relative", reference = "index")  # Bin dates by month, remove exact dates dh <- omop.date_handling(mode = "binned", bin_width = "month")  plan <- ds.omop.plan.events(plan, "conditions",   "condition_occurrence", date_handling = dh) } # }
